Name: Hezron, Son of Pharez
Summary: Hezron was a son of Pharez and a grandson of Judah and Tamar, named among the family that went into Egypt.
KeyStory: Hezron is named with his brother Hamul among Pharez's sons — a different Hezron from the son of Reuben.
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and walk very different paths; God knows each one.
